answer:
Here is what I would raise at your check-up, most important first.

1. Your stool test (FIT) on 4 Nov 2025 was positive, and I see nothing after it. A positive FIT normally needs a colonoscopy, ideally within a few months. Almost a year later there is no colonoscopy, GI referral or repeat test in your records. Please ask about this first. If it was done somewhere else, bring the report so it can be added.

2. Your diabetes check is due. Your last A1c was 6.9% on 16 Feb 2026, more than 8 months ago. Diabetes is usually rechecked every 3 to 6 months. The trend is good: your A1c rose to 8.3% in Jan 2025 after metformin ended in April 2024, then fell to 7.6%, 7.1% and 6.9% after Jardiance (empagliflozin) was started in Feb 2025. The records do not say why metformin was stopped, so ask whether that was a deliberate decision and whether Jardiance alone is still the plan.

3. Cholesterol has not been rechecked since starting a statin. In Feb 2025 your LDL was 131 mg/dL (high) and total cholesterol 212, and atorvastatin 20 mg was started that same month. No lipid panel appears afterwards, so ask for one to see whether the dose is working.

4. Kidney and other diabetes screening. Your kidney numbers are normal (creatinine 0.88, eGFR 69 in Feb 2026), though eGFR has slipped a little from 73. I find no urine albumin test, eye exam or foot exam in these records. These are routine yearly checks for diabetes, and they matter more with Jardiance, so ask whether they were done elsewhere.

5. Something that may look confusing: July 2025 chest pain visit. A pulmonary embolism diagnosis was entered, but it is marked refuted. Your D-dimer was high (0.92), but the CT scan showed no clot, and the diagnosis that stayed was chest wall pain, which resolved. You do not have a pulmonary embolism on record. You could ask that the entry be tidied up so it isn't misread later.

I can only see these records. Other screening (mammogram, bone density, vaccines) is not in them, so I can't say whether it is overdue. Bring up anything you've had done elsewhere.
short: Positive stool test (FIT) on 2025-11-04 with no follow-up colonoscopy on record; A1c last checked 2026-02-16 (6.9%) and LDL 131 not rechecked since atorvastatin started Feb 2025; no urine albumin, eye or foot exam on record.
